properties.geological_classification: Badenoch Glacial Till over Moine Supergroup Metasedimentary Gneiss and Cairngorms Granite intrusion
properties.hydrogeological_context: Strathspey alluvial flood-terrace aquifer; peaty podzol soils
properties.structural_bearing: Spread gravel footings beneath traditional stone walling and compacted pad footings for modern agricultural steel sheds

properties.topography: Undulating Strathspey moorland edge gently descending northwest toward native woodland
properties.ground_cover: Crushed granite aggregate farm tracks, packed earth unpaved access spurs, patchy pastoral grass, rough heath border
properties.drainage: Open field perimeter swales and gravel dispersal along farmyard tracks

properties.typology: Traditional Scottish Highland Farmstead complex (Steading and Residential Farmhouse)
properties.farmhouse_massing: 1.5-storey linear farmhouse, whitewashed harled rubble stone masonry, pitched roof clad in Ballachulish slate or corrugated sheet, small dormers along roofline, end gable stone chimneys
properties.steading_massing: Enclosed U-shaped agricultural steading courtyard with low-pitched corrugated iron/fibre-cement roofs, red oxidized metal cladding, modern central portal-frame barn with grey profile metal roof sheeting and translucent ridge skylights
properties.rectification_directives: Plumb distorted photogrammetry mesh walls to true vertical; flatten and sharpen corrugated barn roof planes, define crisp eave lines on U-shaped outbuildings, align farm track edges cleanly

properties.vegetation: Cairngorms National Park transition zone; dense native Scots Pine (Pinus sylvestris) and Silver Birch (Betula pendula) woodland to the west, heather-flecked pasture grasses turning golden-brown in autumn, low post-and-wire livestock fencing
properties.seasonality: Late autumn foliage with russet bracken, deep green pines, and yellowing birch accents

properties.color_temperature: 2950K low raking golden sunlight with cool 7500K ambient mountain skylight
properties.shadow_dynamics: Long, sharp physical cast shadows extending northeast across pastoral fields and tracks, accentuating roof pitch profiles and mature pine crowns
properties.atmospheric_clarity: Crisp, cold Highland autumnal air with faint translucent moisture haze in the distant Strathspey valley
